messages:
maria: Quick sync — prelaunch SEO runway for the Benchmark launch + webinar page. Need checklist for keywords, schema, redirects, internal links, and registration CTA routing. Who can take lead?
ben: I can own keyword mapping & copy tweaks. I'll post a draft in docs.
dena: I'll take schema + structured data (Event + Webinar + FAQ). Quick Q: webinar is gated — should we include non-indexed registration thank-you?
sam: For gated content, keep landing page indexable, but thank-you should be noindex, yes. Also add Event markup on landing.
gina: I'll audit internal links from blog posts & docs -> landing. Need anchor suggestions.
seo-bot: Suggested schema snippet:
```json
{
  "@context":"https://schema.org",
  "@type":"WebPage",
  "mainEntity": { "@type":"Event", "name":"Benchmarking Redwood Dedicated", "startDate":"2026-05-12T10:00:00-07:00" }
}
```
ben: Keyword cluster to target: "LLM inference cost optimization", "inference latency benchmarks", "dedicated GPU inference". Add longtail: "compare inference runtimes on a100 vs h100".
maria: Redirects: we have old /benchmark to new /benchmarking-dedicated-2026 — create 301s and update canonical. Who will queue redirect PR?
sam: I'll open PR against nginx redirects repo. Include example:
```
rewrite ^/benchmark$ /benchmarking-dedicated-2026 permanent;
```
dena: Schema question — add FAQPage markup with 6 Qs (what's included, pricing, SLA, privacy, how to run benchmark, where to get dataset). I'll draft.
gina: Internal linking plan:
- Add top CTA from product hub -> landing
- Add two contextual links in blog post "Scaling LLMs" (para 3 and 7)
- Add docs side-nav item under "Deployments -> Dedicated"
maria: UTM plan for webinar: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=cta, utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_v1. Gate tracking: pass lead_id param to /thank-you.
ben: Copy note: include target KW in H1 and first paragraph, H2s for comparison sections, meta description <= 155 chars.
sam: Lighthouse perf notes: keep hero image <= 200KB, lazy load, preconnect to fonts.
dena: Also add open graph & twitter card. Use event schema start/end times.
gina: Timeline: PRs for redirects + schema by Tue EOD, internal links changes by Wed, final content QA Thurs, deploy Fri morning. Is that realistic?
maria: Yes. I'll make checklist in Notion and assign owners. Ping me in #launch-day when PRs are ready :thumbsup: 
ben: I'll drop keyword doc link: https://docs.redwood.ai/seo/benchmark-keywords (placeholder)
maria: Anything else?
sam: Run a quick crawl in staging after redirects. I'll script:
```
curl -I https://staging.redwood.ai/benchmarking-dedicated-2026
```
gina: I'll also verify GA4 events for webinar CTA.
maria: Great — locking owners. Thanks team.
